description: Signed-in only, read only. Lists the person's own SpeakBase flashcard sets (title, language, number of cards, set_id). With set_id, returns that set's cards (term and meaning, up to 200) and its study and speaking links.

set_id.description: A set_id from this list or from create_set, or the set's SpeakBase link. Omit to list the sets.

title: My flashcard sets
